_comment: Deliberately invalid candidates. The validator test suite asserts every one of these is rejected, and rejected for the named reason. Design doc §14 makes 'validator rejects known-bad fixtures' the exit criterion for M5. `expect` is a subset assertion: the entry may fail additional rules, but it must fail at least these.
corpusSeed: THEY MOVED THE FROZEN AISLE AND I AM SHAKEN
WHY IS THERE A SECOND FRIDGE
MY GUY WILL COME BY. HE HAS A KEY.
